hook.text: Netflix, Disney+, and Crunchyroll are spending billions on animated content. The boom is real.

buildup.text: Streaming platforms need constant content — animation fills the pipeline with global appeal.

discovery.text: Arcane and Castlevania showed that streaming originals can rival theatrical animation quality.

twist.text: Overproduction is devaluing animation — too much content means less attention per title.

climax.text: Streaming saved animation from theatrical-only economics but created a new race to the bottom.

punchline.text: More animation than ever. Less time to appreciate it.

quiz.question: What streaming animated series matched theatrical quality?
